title: Anna Makes Pancakes
text:
Anna wants to make pancakes. First, she takes eggs, milk and flour from the kitchen. Then she puts the flour in a big bowl. She adds one egg and some milk.

She mixes everything with a spoon until the mix is smooth. Then she heats a pan and pours a little mix into it. After one minute, she turns the pancake. Her brother says the pancakes smell very good.

questions.text: What does Anna take from the kitchen?
What does Anna use to mix everything?
How does Anna's brother probably feel?
Why does Anna wait one minute before she turns the pancake?
options: the pancake needs time to cook on one side
she wants to eat it cold
the milk is still in the bowl

paragraph_translations: Anna chce zrobić naleśniki. Najpierw bierze z kuchni jajka, mleko i mąkę. Potem wsypuje mąkę do dużej miski. Dodaje jedno jajko i trochę mleka.
Miesza wszystko łyżką, aż ciasto będzie gładkie. Potem podgrzewa patelnię i wlewa na nią trochę ciasta. Po minucie przewraca naleśnika. Jej brat mówi, że naleśniki bardzo ładnie pachną.
